Grandma’s house: \((x+(x+2),-x)=(2x+2,-x)\).

Total biking time:
\[
\frac{x}{20}+\frac{x}{20}+\frac{x+2}{14}=1
\]
\[
\frac{x}{10}+\frac{x+2}{14}=1
\]
\[
7x+5(x+2)=70 \Rightarrow 12x=60 \Rightarrow x=5
\]

Grandma’s house is at \((12,-5)\).  
Straight-line distance home:
\[
\sqrt{12^2+5^2}=13
\]
Helicopter time:
\[
\frac{13}{78}\text{ hr}=\frac16\text{ hr}=10\text{ minutes}
\]
